title: Standard words
objective: Answer short ATC calls with the right standard word and your callsign.

phraseologyNote.title: Standard words
phraseologyNote.shortExplanation: Wilco = I understand and will comply. Affirm = yes. Negative = no. Roger = I received your message.
overview: Standard words have one fixed meaning, so a short answer cannot be misread.
WILCO already includes ROGER, so the two are never said together. AFFIRM means yes; NEGATIVE means no.
End each answer with your callsign so ATC knows who answered.
phraseologyNote.whyItMatters: Standard words keep transmissions short and unambiguous.

steps.speaker: atc
steps.prompt: ATC asks you to report when ready. Answer that you will comply.

steps.speaker: atc
steps.prompt: ATC wants to confirm your flight rules. You are VFR: answer yes.

steps.speaker: atc
steps.prompt: ATC gives you traffic information. You can see the traffic.
